sources.title: Phonopy: coherent one-phonon dynamic structure factor and phase conventions
Phonopy: dynamical matrix and displacement eigenvectors
Togo, Chaput, Tadano & Tanaka, Implementation strategies in phonopy and phono3py (2023)

conventions.model: one-dimensional longitudinal diatomic harmonic chain; no imported Phonopy structure factor
conventions.eigenvector: cell-periodic: u_lk proportional to e_k(q) exp(i q l a)/sqrt(m_k)
conventions.displacementScale: e/sqrt(m) gives relative displacement shape, not a calibrated displacement in Angstrom
conventions.atomicAmplitude: Q_parallel b_k exp(i Q_parallel tau_k) conjugate(e_k)/sqrt(m_k)
conventions.relativeWeight: signed dimensionless b; no Debye-Waller or kinematic prefactor
conventions.normalization: normalizedStrength removes Q_parallel squared; null at zero projection; computed before multiplying Q to avoid underflow
conventions.gauge: e -> i e changes A -> -i A and preserves strength
conventions.relativePhase: multiplying B alone by i changes relative displacement when both components are nonzero; a one-atom vector can instead be unchanged or differ only by a common phase (overlap test tolerance 1e-12). eigenResidual separately tests whether it remains an eigenmode; this is not a recalculated spectrum
conventions.degeneracy: the original spectrum groups energies within 1e-8 meV; mixing is shown only when their spread is at most 64 machine eps times max(1, energy). The eigenResidual is reported; numerical grouping alone does not establish exact degeneracy. Complete subspace strength is invariant under unitary changes of basis
conventions.excluded: excluded low-energy groups retain amplitudes but have null inverse-energy/Bose factors and original zero inelastic weights

warnings: 理想一维双原子纵向谐链的相干一声子模型；参数与散射权重由用户给定，不是 NaCl、NiO 或任何材料的拟合。
完整散射向量 Q 与约化声子 q 不同：Q∥=Q cosθ，q=Q∥ mod 2π/a。改变夹角同时改变动量匹配与纵向 Q·e 投影。
相干权重 bA/bB 是有符号的相对常数，不是已校准散射长度或随 Q 变化的 X 射线形状因子。结果省略截面运动学常数与 Debye–Waller 因子。
无限一维谐链存在长波涨落问题；本页只演示有限 Q/能量窗口及显式低能截断下的一声子运动学，不声称给出无限链的完整有限温度结构因子。
所有能量低于 0.25 meV 的模均从非弹性谱排除，尤其 q=0 的刚体声学模。没有用展宽把 1/ω 奇点变成弹性峰；未含弹性、多声子或准弹性贡献。
Gaussian 的 σ 是能量标准差，FWHM=2√(2ln2)σ。Stokes位于正能量（探针向晶格传能），anti-Stokes位于负能量；详细平衡核验的是未展宽单模权重，非展宽后逐点曲线。
本页没有导入 Phonopy 数据。现有导入器可用于检查结构与单模；完整散射还需明确 Å 单位、原胞、质量、匹配 q 点的全部复本征矢和散射权重，不能由频率或单模动画补全。
热图的 31 个 Q 点共有 1 个模因低能截断被排除；近倒格点亮度依赖此截断，比较时须保持它相同。
